task_definition.task_description: Please get me an AAPL quote in EUR and estimate the trading cost for 170.25 worth of stock at the VIP rate. Then check the current NASDAQ market window, send that market-status update to investor_99 in the app with high priority, analyze the text “NASDAQ session regular, next transition 16:00 EST,” and after that create a Market Analysis Report with that content and email it to investor_99 with medium priority.
